issues.description: Method Milkable.messageOnMilk(): the problem statement declares this method should return a String containing the message "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" (UML and textual description). In the solution, the Milkable interface declares messageOnMilk() returning boolean, and Seal and Goat implement it by printing the message and returning true. This contradicts the exercise API and will confuse students and tests that expect a String return value (for example, callers like Main use System.out.println(m.messageOnMilk()) expecting a String message).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the interface and implementations with the problem statement: change Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return String. Update Seal and Goat to return the constructed message String (e.g., "Seal Clarabelle is milked" / "Goat Buttinsky is milked") instead of printing and returning boolean. Update any callers (e.g., Main or tests) to print or use the returned String (System.out.println(m.messageOnMilk())). This preserves the intended API in the UML/text and avoids confusing students or breaking tests that expect a String return.
